# Welcome to the MasterRunners Page.

MasterRunners is a free-to-play multiplayer hand based movement game surrounding a variety of entertaining gamemodes, cosmetics, obstacles, etc.

With over **10+ gamemodes** and an **active player count of 100,000+**, we guarantee this game is worth your time. We have lots to offer, so what are you waiting for!?

# What you can do:
- Play Gamemodes with players across the **WORLD**. MasterRunners can be played worldwide and with our **advanced multiplayer system**, you can enjoy multiplayer & have a very fun time. For the gamemodes, we build special gamemodes that have never been used in others games making us stand out and more fun.
![{"height":1440,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-lga3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/86624299_1750476142452666_8570864821809744346_n.png?_nc_cat=107&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=d_5Ks9NXTcMQ7kNvgGs4CO0&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lga3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCla2EU62HuSCYcQqVu0auZcjlOBkhneDfTlI7JKxD63g&oe=672F486D)
- Chill with friends and have a **great time.** With areas such as the "Main Hub", you can relax and have a calming time with buddies as you talk to your hearts desire.
![{"height":1440,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-lga3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982492_509486201534965_7333984808768808414_n.png?_nc_cat=101&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=7oCWi7nbraMQ7kNvgGGVmGg&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lga3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYD7Pf-NcadKStv5PxckPcq09qrUd3e_jz66WJ9B-ravXA&oe=672F32A7)
- Shop for new cosmetics at Gregson's Shop with the free in-game currency... Energy! Using energy, you can get all kinds of cosmetics of any type just with one click. This is how you can customize your character!
![{"height":1440,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-lga3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982613_1216230169384631_6163698231671476667_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=jxri7-bSfmcQ7kNvgEKP5MT&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lga3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYC4l9o1UjsUQkeBJ4w-qzfUfVBtYwpO-aQX8L0limH5cQ&oe=672F2AF5)

- **Survive Monsters..**
![{"height":1440,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-lga3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974658_770419331698632_3320560763268773557_n.png?_nc_cat=107&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=EE1FcJjj9SwQ7kNvgGOc1ZW&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lga3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDQaTUXFo--oEdCv9I8CXnEWpcqejHacedlFLyoi8jSjg&oe=672F38E7)

And more. 

There is lots to do in MasterRunners, so check it out **TODAY!**
